evals.prompt: Convert the cell biology notes file into RemNote flashcards. Read the file at evals/samples/cell-biology-notes.md, analyze all the biological concepts, definitions, organelles, and processes described. Generate a comprehensive set of flashcards that covers all the key information, choosing the appropriate card type for each piece of information according to the decision tree. Output the flashcards to evals/samples/cell-biology-notes-flashcards.md.
evals.expected_output: A markdown file containing RemNote flashcard syntax with a variety of card types (Concept, Descriptor, Cloze, Basic, Multi-Line) covering cell structures, organelles, processes, and definitions.

assertions.name: file_exists_and_non_empty
assertions.description: Output file exists and contains at least 20 flashcards

assertions.name: no_metadata
assertions.description: Contains no HTML comments or metadata

evals.prompt: Convert the Python basics notes file into RemNote flashcards. Read the file at evals/samples/python-basics-notes.md, analyze the programming concepts, data types, syntax, and language features described. Generate a comprehensive set of flashcards choosing the best card type for each concept. Pay attention to bidirectional relationships (like comparing strings vs lists vs tuples) and exam-preparation style distinctions. Output the flashcards to evals/samples/python-basics-notes-flashcards.md.
evals.expected_output: A markdown file containing RemNote flashcard syntax with a mix of Concept, Cloze, Bidirectional Basic, Multiple-Choice, and other card types covering Python fundamentals.

assertions.name: file_exists_and_non_empty
assertions.description: Output file exists and contains at least 20 flashcards

assertions.name: no_metadata
assertions.description: Contains no HTML comments or metadata

evals.prompt: Convert the World War II notes file into RemNote flashcards. Read the file at evals/samples/world-war-2-notes.md, analyze all the historical facts, dates, events, causes, and consequences described. Generate a comprehensive set of flashcards covering the war's timeline, key battles, leaders, causes, and consequences. Use appropriate card types for factual information, dates, and relationships. Output the flashcards to evals/samples/world-war-2-notes-flashcards.md.
evals.expected_output: A markdown file containing RemNote flashcard syntax with flashcards covering dates, events, leaders, battles, and historical facts related to World War II.

assertions.name: file_exists_and_non_empty
assertions.description: Output file exists and contains at least 25 flashcards

assertions.name: has_date_facts
assertions.description: Contains at least 5 flashcards with dates

assertions.name: no_metadata
assertions.description: Contains no HTML comments or metadata
